title: Code and data for: Gradient boosting correction of SEAS5 monthly rainfall forecasts for 38 provinces in Indonesia
description: Code, SEAS5 and CHIRPS province data, forecasts and verification results for the manuscript "Gradient boosting correction of SEAS5 monthly rainfall forecasts for 38 provinces in Indonesia: A comparison with quantile mapping". LightGBM gradient boosting is compared with climatology, damped anomaly persistence, raw SEAS5, mean-bias correction, empirical quantile mapping and linear MOS for monthly rainfall in the 38 provinces of Indonesia at lead times of one to six months, in a rolling-origin test over 2005-2024. Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information 2026.
